mathematical_meanings: Left image: y denotes the unknown length of the vertical leg. Right image: y denotes the unknown length of the upper vertical segment.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at y beside the left vertical leg; the right occurrence is at y beside the upper segment of the vertical transversal. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-length variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
